lines.en: This is a portrait of a young woman.
Who is she, Grandma?
She was the artist's daughter long ago.
Her expression is so calm.
Yes. Look at the old man behind her.
lines.ko: 네. 뒤에 있는 나이 든 남자를 봐요.

lines.en: Is he her father?
I think so. Two people, one family.
lines.ko: 그런 것 같아요. 두 사람, 한 가족이죠.

lines.en: Why did the artist paint them back then?
lines.ko: 화가는 그때 왜 그 사람들을 그렸어요?

lines.en: He loved his family. That's the reason.
I will draw your portrait tomorrow, Grandma!
This old portrait looks like my mother.
lines.ko: 이 오래된 초상화는 제 어머니를 닮았어요.

lines.en: Oh! The woman has a gentle expression.
Yes. My mother smiled like that when I was young.
lines.ko: 네. 제가 어릴 때 어머니가 저렇게 웃으셨어요.

lines.en: Did you have a family portrait then?
We had one many years ago.
Where is that picture now?
My daughter keeps it at her house.
Will you show it to me next time?
Sure. Every person in it looks so happy.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 그 안의 모든 사람이 정말 행복해 보여요.

lines.en: Thank you for telling me your story.
